{{Tabs|History = No}} {{For|other uses of [[Elf (Disambiguation)|Elf]]|other uses of [[Snow (Disambiguation)|Snow]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Snowball Elf |image-static = SnowballElfDec25.png |image-dynamic = SnowballElfDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Elf Camp]] |type = Humanoid |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]10s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]15 |damage_type = Collision
Single |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage_Icon.png|20px|Damage]]4 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]2 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]17 |speed = 6 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snowball Elf''' is the second unit that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Levels 1. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Snowball Elf''' has a spawnrate of 10 seconds. The '''Snowball Elf''' wields a snowball which it uses to attack enemies. As the snowball is a projectile, it may not hit the intended target or miss an enemy entirely. When there are enemies in its range, it will stop moving to throw snowballs at enemies. It will continue walking when there are no enemies left in its range. The '''Snowball Elf''' is replaced by the [[Cannoneer Elf]] for the Level 2 [[Elf Camp]] and by the [[Gunner Elf]] for the Level 3-4 [[Elf Camp]]. There is a limit of 30 '''Snowball Elves''' per [[Elf Camp]]. ==Appearance== The '''Snowball Elf''' has dark skin and brown hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, green and red hat with golden stars, dark green pants and brown shoes. It wields a snowball that it attacks enemies with. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:SnowballElf.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierSnowballElf.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Snowball Elf''' is great for weak enemies that spawn initially during the round, like the [[Normal]], [[Abnormal]], [[Speedy]] or [[Quick]]. **Its ranged attack also allows it to deal with enemies like the [[Slow]] and [[Heavy]] quite well. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Snowball Elf''' will spawn per Level 1 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path. **The snowballs thrown by the '''Snowball Elf''' can also hit a flying enemy if that enemy gets in the way of the intended target, however, this should not be relied on. **The '''Snowball Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s. *The '''Snowball Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. **Do note that its ranged attack is still affected by defense. *The '''Snowball Elf''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Snowball Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and an '''Snowball Elf''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly defeated. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' -
